highlights: High-quality Ugreen USB cable for virtually all devices equipped with a micro USB connector .
With its help, we will quickly synchronize the data and safely charge our equipment.
The cable is made of environmentally friendly PVC, which guarantees flexibility and high durability.
An undoubted advantage is also the fact that it is really difficult to get it mixed up. Inside the material, there is a wire made of pure copper, which ensures stable data transmission.
Plus nickel-plated plugs for better performance. Perfect for all the most popular smartphones , tablets and cameras.
Compatibility: devices with a micro USB port
